name: Seirei Kishi Aqueal Reizoku no Hanayome
original_name: 精霊騎士アクエアル 隷属の花嫁
source:
Aqueal is a spirit of water knight summoned from a mysterious fountain during the crisis in a human kingdom. She loses power in the process, but she can regain the power if she drinks body fluids. There are a lot of male volunteers to provide her with as much sperm as she needs.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
阿奎尔是一位水骑士的灵魂，在人类王国的危机期间从神秘的喷泉中被召唤出来。在此过程中她会失去力量，但如果她喝下体液就可以重新获得力量。有很多男性志愿者为她提供尽可能多的精子。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
